title: Chicken Scheme 6.0
summary: Chicken Scheme 6.0.0 is a major release of the popular Scheme programming language implementation that compiles Scheme code to C, featuring updated core libraries, improved performance, and breaking changes from previous versions.
problem_solved: Provides a production-ready Scheme implementation that bridges high-level functional programming with efficient C-level performance for cross-platform development.
why_valuable: Chicken Scheme remains one of the most practical and mature Scheme implementations, offering extensive libraries and excellent C interop for developers needing both functional programming expressiveness and system-level performance.
